item.jaymoskingdoms.grave_lure.tooltip: Tear it open in the dark and the dead will come.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hordes.0: The dead keep to their graves, mostly.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hordes.1: Some nights they walk in twos and threes.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hordes.2: They gather in the dark now, and walk together.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hordes.3: Whole crowds of them on the road after dark. They know my scent.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hordes.4: The nights belong to them. Even the ground by my door has been turned.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ward_bell.0: The dead won't come up within sound of a bell, so long as it stands on iron. The old priests knew.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ward_bell.1: Our temple bell rings from a square of iron, three by three. That's why the dead walk round us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ward_bell.2: Gold under a bell carries further than iron. Diamond further still, they say.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ward_bell.3: My grandmother swore by a netherite heart under the bell. Nothing rose for a hundred paces.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ward_bell.4: Half a square of iron does nothing. Every block, or the dead don't listen.
